candidates.title: [Feature]: Option to suppress EOS inside the reasoning block and force `reasoning_end` first (Qwen3.8 samples `<|im_end|>` mid-`<think>`, returning empty `content` with `finish_reason: stop`)
candidates.snippet: ### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch  **Problem.** With `--reasoning-parser qwen3`, Qwen3.8-27B sometimes samples `<|im_end|>` *inside* the `<think>` block. vLLM treats it as EOS, the request ends with `finish_reason: "stop"`, the parser routes everything to `reasoning_content`, and `content` is empty. The call is HTTP 200 and looks complete; thousands of tokens were spent; the budget was not reached. A client cannot tell this apart from a legitimate empty answer.  This is not a parser bug an

candidates.title: [Bug]: /v1/embeddings deadlocks when a truncated input follows a short one in the same request
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  On the CUDA build, a single `/v1/embeddings` request containing **a short input followed by an input long enough to be truncated** never returns. The engine reports the request as running and then makes no progress:  ``` Engine 000: Avg prompt throughput: 0.0 tokens/s, Avg generation throughput: 0.0 tokens/s,             Running: 1 reqs, Waiting: 0 reqs ```  The GPU sits at 0% utilisation with memory still allocated. `EngineCore` is alive — `STAT=SLl`, `WCHAN=hrtimer_nanosleep`, ~13%

candidates.title: qwen2.5-coder:3b-instruct q2_K / q3_K_S / q3_K_M / q3_K_L library artifacts are functionally broken (0% on code tasks; sibling quants unaffected)
candidates.snippet: The official library artifacts for Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct at four low-bit quantization levels produce fluent-looking but entirely non-functional output. On a 15-task functional smoke suite (easy HumanEval+ tasks that every other Qwen2.5-Coder configuration passes at 87-100%), all four score 0/15:  | tag | smoke pass | failure signature | |---|---|---| | `qwen2.5-coder:3b-instruct-q2_K` | 0/15 | runaway generation, 100% of outputs hit the token cap | | `qwen2.5-coder:3b-instruct-q3_K_S` | 0/1
